scope.mode: riskoff trailing stop; activation is not close-to-flat
scope.anchor: short min(low since activation), long max(high since activation)
scope.stop_detection: completed 5m close crosses stop; next open executes
scope.post_stop_lockout: same-side reentry suppressed until baseline leaves stopped direction
scope.priority: baseline reversal > riskoff activation > riskoff stop
scope.hard_gate: top20_winner_exits<=2, live_case_hit, oos_return>=50% baseline, year_losses<=year_wins, net_delta_pnl_proxy>0
